text:
The Weaver spins threads of the unseen,

Not with needles of logic, but with dreams of what could be.

When knots of trouble bind the mind,

It is the spark of the Muse that sets the tangled skein free.

For solutions lie not always in the well-trodden path,

But in the uncharted wilds where imagination breathes.

Seek the hidden pathways, the whispers of the unseen,

And the answer will reveal itself, like a flower blooming in the desert.
